condition3_mutations_comment: The fixed mutation rows scripts/run_relay_authority_mutations.sh runs, in order. Not read by check_relay_authority_contract.py; kept honest by tests/test_relay_authority_mutations.py, which runs the script and compares the MUTATION_RESULT names, mutated files and named targets against this list. The declared floor stays four; S4-m5/S4-m6 are the #5071 relay-tail S4 destructive-fence rows and S4-m7 is its r2 repair row, which reopens the fence's judge/commit window instead of neutering the verdict.

lanes.name: t1-sink-terminal-handoff
lanes.derivation: Measured on t1-s1-shadow-journal commit c94ebc3715f7a898e61d8bdea6ed7cfef665e581 with cargo test --lib services::discord::session_relay_sink -- --list; 105 named tests were selected. This branch contains the DeliveryJournal single-writer contract: pg_store.rs exposes the raw append entry point only within the journal module, check_delivery_journal_raw_writer.py enforces its exact allowlist, and ci-script-checks.sh runs that gate.

lanes.name: t2-intake-dispatched-terminal-receipt
lanes.reason: No T2 contract target exists yet: the current worker still advances spawned directly to done after execute_intake_turn_core returns, and neither dispatched nor a terminal-receipt-owned done transition exists.

lanes.name: t3-execution-registry-nonce
lanes.reason: No T3 contract target exists yet: durable turn_nonce values are persisted, but the execution registry and contract/registry admission wiring that T3 will add do not exist.

lanes.name: t4-single-actor-recovery-decision
lanes.derivation: Re-measured with the declared command plus -- --list on the #5071 relay-tail S4 branch over origin/main 0d6e810f9: 50 named tests were selected, up from the 43 pinned on 0ae1c5b77. This is the existing recovery planner/apply contract module around plan_relay_recovery, and it is also where the S4-m5 mutation target post_gate_identity_matched_live_delivery_lease_blocks_dead_frontier_watcher_cancel lives, so this floor is what keeps that target selectable.

lanes.name: t5-structural-signal-authority-teardown
lanes.reason: No T5 contract target exists yet: structural signals and inflight still participate in recovery/lifecycle authority, so authority teardown has not been implemented or tested.

lanes.name: relay-e2e-local-model-queue-wake
lanes.derivation: Measured on origin/main 0ae1c5b77 with the declared command plus -- --list. This Rust production-path E2E drives the local Discord mock, mailbox lifecycle, durable queue wake, and production workers; dashboard Playwright is unrelated and nightly-only.
